# Generated by roster from {HOME}/inv/roster.yml
# Don't edit by hand: change roster.yml and run `roster sync`.

Host agent-box
    HostName 10.0.0.7
    User ops
    Port 22
    UserKnownHostsFile "{HOME}/.ssh/roster_known_hosts"
    StrictHostKeyChecking accept-new
    ConnectTimeout 10
    ServerAliveInterval 30
    ControlMaster auto
    ControlPath "{HOME}/.ssh/cm-%C"
    ControlPersist 10m

# Build box [dev]
# Runs the nightly build
Host build-pi
    HostName 10.0.0.5
    User ops
    Port 22
    UserKnownHostsFile "{HOME}/.ssh/roster_known_hosts"
    StrictHostKeyChecking accept-new
    ConnectTimeout 10
    ServerAliveInterval 30
    ControlMaster auto
    ControlPath "{HOME}/.ssh/cm-%C"
    ControlPersist 10m
    IdentityFile "{HOME}/.ssh/roster_ed25519"
    IdentitiesOnly yes

Host esx
    HostName 10.0.0.6
    User ops
    Port 2222
    UserKnownHostsFile "{HOME}/.ssh/roster_known_hosts"
    StrictHostKeyChecking accept-new
    ConnectTimeout 10
    ServerAliveInterval 30
    ControlMaster auto
    ControlPath "{HOME}/.ssh/cm-%C"
    ControlPersist 10m
    IdentitiesOnly yes
